metadata.title: Home Improvement Services Marketplace Data Assets
metadata.description: Logical data assets for homeowner intent, professional supply, matching, monetization, trust, affiliates, analytics, and acquired-brand integration.

rootGroups.name: Identity, Consent, and Party Data
rootGroups.description: People, businesses, platform identities, verification evidence, consent, and access state.

subGroups.name: Homeowner identity and consent
subGroups.description: Contactable homeowner identity and purpose-specific permission evidence.

assets.name: Homeowner Profile
assets.description: Canonical homeowner identity link, verified contact routes, locale, preferences, and account state.
assets.accessScope: The homeowner and authorized customer, quality, privacy, and support workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Identifies who submitted or manages a project and how Solvari may contact them.

interfaces.name: homeowner profile api
interfaces.description: Purpose-filtered profile and contact access.

governance.retention: Retain only while an account, active project, support need, or documented legal basis requires it; then delete or anonymize.
governance.sharingPolicy: Share contact data only with authorized staff and consented matched professionals for the stated project purpose.

assets.name: Consent Record
assets.description: Versioned evidence of purpose, notice, channel, source, partner, recipient treatment, choice, and withdrawal.
assets.accessScope: Authorized privacy, identity, intake, matching, communication, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Proves what data use and disclosure the person understood and accepted at a point in time.

interfaces.name: consent evidence api
interfaces.description: Records and evaluates purpose-specific consent state.

governance.retention: Retain consent and withdrawal evidence according to the approved privacy and claims schedule, separately from optional marketing data.
governance.sharingPolicy: Expose only the decision and minimum evidence required for the requesting purpose.

subGroups.name: Professional and platform identity
subGroups.description: Canonical business participation, verification, and scoped platform access.

assets.name: Specialist Account
assets.description: Canonical specialist legal entity, account relationship, contacts, contracting context, and participation status.
assets.accessScope: Professional administrators and authorized onboarding, commercial, trust, finance, and support staff.
assets.businessMeaning: Defines the business that participates, pays, receives leads, and accumulates reputation.

interfaces.name: specialist account api
interfaces.description: Canonical professional identity and participation status.

governance.retention: Retain for the active commercial relationship and approved post-termination legal, complaint, and accounting periods.
governance.sharingPolicy: Publish only approved business fields; restrict private contacts and contractual data.

assets.name: Specialist Verification
assets.description: Evidence, checklist version, result, reviewer, expiry, re-check, restriction, and appeal for professional admission.
assets.accessScope: Authorized professional verification, trust, legal, and appeal workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Supports the dated decision that a professional may participate and which claims can be displayed.

interfaces.name: specialist verification api
interfaces.description: Current status and purpose-filtered evidence summary.

governance.retention: Retain verification and adverse-decision evidence under the approved trust, appeal, and legal schedule.
governance.sharingPolicy: Display verification status and permitted claims; restrict raw documents and adverse evidence.

assets.name: Access and Tenant Entitlement
assets.description: Platform identity links, brand and country tenants, roles, service principals, sessions, policies, and authorization decisions.
assets.accessScope: Identity services and tightly controlled security and access-administration workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Controls who or which application may act on which brand, market, account, and data purpose.

interfaces.name: identity and authorization api
interfaces.description: Authentication and scoped authorization decisions.

governance.retention: Keep active identity and authorization state while needed; retain security audit references under the approved security schedule.
governance.sharingPolicy: Never expose credentials; disclose only minimum identity and authorization claims to approved services.

rootGroups.name: Project, Supply, and Marketplace Decision Data
rootGroups.description: The product taxonomy, homeowner project, professional operating scope, and decisions that qualify, match, price, and distribute demand.

subGroups.name: Project context and professional supply
subGroups.description: What work is wanted, where, when, and which professionals can credibly deliver it.

assets.name: Project Taxonomy
assets.description: Versioned countries, categories, services, synonyms, questions, answer rules, guidance, and qualification mappings.
assets.accessScope: Product, content, matching, operations, integration, and approved public read surfaces.
assets.businessMeaning: Provides a shared language for homeowner intent, professional services, matching, content, pricing, and reporting.

interfaces.name: project taxonomy api
interfaces.description: Versioned category and question definitions.

governance.retention: Retain published versions while requests, contracts, content, or decisions still reference them.
governance.sharingPolicy: Approved published definitions may be public; draft rules and commercial mappings remain internal.

assets.name: Property Context
assets.description: Homeowner-declared address-linked building characteristics relevant to current and future project scoping.
assets.accessScope: The homeowner and authorized project, qualification, matching, and support workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Avoids repeatedly asking for stable property context while keeping homeowner control over reuse.

interfaces.name: property context api
interfaces.description: Purpose-filtered declared property characteristics.

governance.retention: Retain only with an active account and consented reuse purpose; remove or minimize on request subject to legal exceptions.
governance.sharingPolicy: Share only project-relevant fields with selected professionals after consent.

assets.name: Project Request
assets.description: Draft and submitted project intent, category answers, location, timing, budget context, urgency, source, and lifecycle state.
assets.accessScope: The homeowner, consented professionals, and authorized intake, matching, quality, support, analytics, and privacy workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: The canonical expression of homeowner demand used to qualify, match, communicate, and learn.

interfaces.name: project request api
interfaces.description: Draft, submit, qualify, and purpose-filtered request access.

governance.retention: Retain for active matching, contact, outcome, complaint, and approved analytical periods; then delete or anonymize.
governance.sharingPolicy: Before acquisition show only safe preview fields; disclose consented contact and detail only to selected recipients.

assets.name: Request Media
assets.description: Metadata, ownership, scan result, access grants, retention, and lifecycle for homeowner-supplied project photos and documents.
assets.accessScope: The homeowner, selected professionals, and authorized qualification, trust, support, and privacy workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Gives specialists necessary visual context while controlling accidental personal or household exposure.

interfaces.name: request media access api
interfaces.description: Short-lived purpose-specific upload and download grants.

governance.retention: Retain only for the project, related dispute, and approved safety period; expire access and delete promptly thereafter.
governance.sharingPolicy: Use short-lived authorized access; never publish request media as portfolio content without separate permission.

assets.name: Specialist Profile
assets.description: Publication-ready company story, services, regions, evidence, portfolio media, certifications, and moderation state.
assets.accessScope: Public read for approved fields; professional and authorized moderation write access.
assets.businessMeaning: The professional's verified marketplace identity and evidence used by homeowners to assess fit.

interfaces.name: specialist profile api
interfaces.description: Draft and publication-safe profile access.

governance.retention: Retain active and historically displayed versions while needed for claims, reviews, and audit; minimize removed personal details.
governance.sharingPolicy: Publish only approved profile fields and licensed portfolio media.

assets.name: Service Coverage and Capacity
assets.description: Professional categories, geographic coverage, exclusions, limits, budget preferences, capacity calendar, and pauses.
assets.accessScope: The professional and authorized matching, campaign, commercial, quality, and support workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Expresses where and when a professional is currently willing and able to receive demand.

interfaces.name: service coverage and capacity api
interfaces.description: Current eligibility and capacity decision input.

governance.retention: Retain active configuration and versions needed to explain historical allocation decisions.
governance.sharingPolicy: Expose only decision-relevant availability to matching and safe summary context to homeowners.

subGroups.name: Qualification, matching, pricing, and lead lifecycle
subGroups.description: Evidence and decisions that turn project intent into controlled professional opportunity.

assets.name: Qualification Decision
assets.description: Automated and human evidence, confidence, corrections, duplicate links, reason codes, overrides, and release state.
assets.accessScope: Authorized qualification, matching, trust, case, privacy, audit, and limited explanation workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Explains why a request was accepted, enriched, held, or rejected and what was changed.

interfaces.name: qualification decision api
interfaces.description: Current state and purpose-filtered decision evidence.

governance.retention: Retain while needed to explain distribution, partner acceptance, claims, appeals, and model monitoring.
governance.sharingPolicy: Share explanation-safe reasons; restrict internal features, raw risk evidence, and unrelated personal data.

assets.name: Match Decision
assets.description: Candidate professionals, eligibility features, exclusions, rank, sharing limit, approval, override, and disclosure history.
assets.accessScope: Authorized matching, allocation, operations, trust, case, audit, and explanation workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: The reconstructable decision connecting a qualified homeowner request to eligible professional recipients.

interfaces.name: match decision api
interfaces.description: Candidate, approval, and explanation-safe match state.

governance.retention: Retain while needed to explain lead distribution, ranking, claims, complaints, and decision quality.
governance.sharingPolicy: Show participants relevant match explanations without exposing another professional's confidential features.

assets.name: Lead Price Decision
assets.description: Pricing policy version, category, region, supply-demand and quality features, credit quote, validity, experiment, and realized price.
assets.accessScope: Authorized pricing, professional product, commercial, finance, operations, audit, and experiment workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Explains the credit price offered for access to a specific lead under the active rules.

interfaces.name: lead price decision api
interfaces.description: Versioned quote and explanation-safe context.

governance.retention: Retain quotes and realized treatments for contract, claim, experiment, fairness, and revenue reconciliation periods.
governance.sharingPolicy: Show the quoted price and permitted explanation to the eligible professional; restrict strategy and peer features.

assets.name: Lead Entitlement
assets.description: Package capability, trial, credit grant, balance, hold, consumption, expiry, reversal, support, ranking, campaign, CRM, and API rights.
assets.accessScope: The professional and authorized entitlement, lead, campaign, billing, finance, claims, support, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Determines what marketplace services a professional may use and how credits change.

interfaces.name: lead entitlement api
interfaces.description: Eligibility, reservation, consumption, and balance decisions.

governance.retention: Retain current balances and historical movements for the contractual, claim, accounting, and audit schedule.
governance.sharingPolicy: Expose full state only to the account and authorized staff; downstream systems receive scoped eligibility decisions.

assets.name: Lead Transaction
assets.description: Lead availability, preview, reservation, acquisition or campaign allocation, recipient disclosure, credit movement reference, status, and outcome.
assets.accessScope: The involved homeowner and professional plus authorized lead, campaign, trust, case, finance, support, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: The auditable commercial and disclosure event by which a professional receives a homeowner opportunity.

interfaces.name: lead transaction api
interfaces.description: Safe preview, acquisition, recipient, status, and outcome access.

governance.retention: Retain through contact, claims, complaints, commercial reconciliation, and approved analytical periods; then minimize or anonymize.
governance.sharingPolicy: Before acquisition expose safe preview fields; after acquisition disclose only the consented project and contact data to selected recipients.

assets.name: Campaign Configuration
assets.description: Professional campaign category, region, budget, volume, pacing, caps, package constraints, pause calendar, allocation state, and performance guardrails.
assets.accessScope: The professional and authorized campaign, commercial, matching, quality, support, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Defines how qualified leads may be delivered automatically to a professional account.

interfaces.name: campaign configuration api
interfaces.description: Campaign create, pause, pace, budget, and status access.

governance.retention: Retain active configuration and versions required to explain historical delivery and billing.
governance.sharingPolicy: Restrict to the account and authorized operational systems; aggregate benchmarks must not reveal peer strategy.

rootGroups.name: Interaction, Trust, and Commercial Data
rootGroups.description: Professional pipeline, communication, reputation, integrity, cases, billing, and affiliate settlement.

subGroups.name: Interaction and professional outcome
subGroups.description: What happened after demand was distributed and how participants communicated.

assets.name: Professional Pipeline
assets.description: Professional lead stage, contact attempts, tasks, appointments, notes, quote status, close reason, and completion outcome.
assets.accessScope: The acquiring professional and authorized support, quality, claims, analytics, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Shows how an acquired lead progressed and provides the professional's operational sales workflow.

interfaces.name: professional pipeline api
interfaces.description: Lead-stage, task, appointment, and outcome access.

governance.retention: Retain for the professional workflow, related claims, and approved performance analysis; then minimize personal notes.
governance.sharingPolicy: Restrict to the involved professional account and purpose-authorized staff; never expose one professional's notes to another.

assets.name: Conversation Event
assets.description: Permission-aware thread, participant, message, contact-disclosure, template, reminder, delivery, bounce, and suppression event.
assets.accessScope: Conversation participants and authorized support, trust, case, privacy, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Preserves the communication state necessary to coordinate contact and resolve delivery or conduct disputes.

interfaces.name: conversation api
interfaces.description: Participant- and purpose-filtered thread and delivery access.

governance.retention: Retain only for active contact, support, claims, safety, and approved legal periods; minimize message content thereafter.
governance.sharingPolicy: Limit content to participants and authorized case purposes; separate transactional from optional marketing communication.

assets.name: Marketplace Outcome Event
assets.description: Governed events for request completion, qualification, match, contact, appointment, quote, selection, job win, completion, review, claim, renewal, and churn.
assets.accessScope: Authorized product, operations, data, quality, commercial, and privacy workflows using minimized identifiers.
assets.businessMeaning: Provides a consistent measurable lifecycle across customers, products, brands, channels, and experiments.

interfaces.name: marketplace outcome stream
interfaces.description: Contracted lifecycle events and governed aggregates.

governance.retention: Keep identifiable events only for approved operational and measurement windows; aggregate or anonymize for longer-term trends.
governance.sharingPolicy: Use purpose-filtered views, minimized identifiers, governed metrics, and aggregation thresholds.

assets.name: Professional Performance Aggregate
assets.description: Governed professional and cohort measures for lead mix, response speed, pipeline conversion, claims, spend, credit use, profile quality, capacity, and recommendations.
assets.accessScope: The professional's own account and authorized account, product, quality, and analytical workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Explains professional marketplace value and supports capacity, follow-up, profile, and spend decisions.

interfaces.name: professional performance api
interfaces.description: Account metrics, safe cohort benchmarks, and recommendation evidence.

governance.retention: Retain current and historical aggregates while useful for the account relationship and approved trend analysis.
governance.sharingPolicy: Show account-level measures only to that account; apply cohort thresholds and suppress peer-identifying detail.

subGroups.name: Trust, cases, and communications delivery
subGroups.description: Authentic reputation, risk signals, complaints, claims, remedies, and channel evidence.

assets.name: Review and Reputation
assets.description: Review content, experience provenance, eligibility, moderation, professional response, publication state, score calculation, and display disclosure.
assets.accessScope: Public approved review views; controlled reviewer, professional-response, moderation, trust, legal, and appeal access.
assets.businessMeaning: Provides authentic experience evidence and an explainable professional reputation signal.

interfaces.name: review and reputation api
interfaces.description: Eligible submission and publication-safe reputation access.

governance.retention: Retain published reviews and provenance under the documented review policy; honor valid removal and correction rights while preserving audit evidence.
governance.sharingPolicy: Publish only moderated content and documented score methodology; restrict raw provenance and integrity evidence.

assets.name: Trust and Risk Signal
assets.description: Professional, homeowner, affiliate, review, payment, device, duplicate, complaint, behavior, restriction, and appeal evidence used for marketplace integrity.
assets.accessScope: Tightly authorized trust, verification, qualification, matching, case, privacy, security, and appeal workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Supports prevention and investigation of abuse while requiring proportional, explainable treatment and human review for impactful action.

interfaces.name: marketplace integrity api
interfaces.description: Purpose-filtered risk signals, decisions, restrictions, and reasons.

governance.retention: Use risk-type-specific approved retention; review necessity regularly and preserve appeal evidence for impactful decisions.
governance.sharingPolicy: Expose only explanation-safe outcomes to participants; protect raw signals, lists, and unrelated third-party data.

assets.name: Case and Claim
assets.description: Complaint, lead claim, review dispute, privacy request, integrity appeal, evidence, policy version, assignment, decision, remedy, communication, and closure.
assets.accessScope: The submitting party and authorized case, trust, legal, privacy, finance, security, and audit workflows according to case type.
assets.businessMeaning: The canonical evidence and resolution record for marketplace failures and contested decisions.

interfaces.name: case and claim api
interfaces.description: Submission, evidence, assignment, decision, remedy, and status access.

governance.retention: Retain according to case type, legal need, limitation, appeal, and audit schedules; segregate especially sensitive evidence.
governance.sharingPolicy: Use case-type access controls and disclose only the evidence and reasoning appropriate to each party.

assets.name: Communication Delivery
assets.description: Purpose, template, locale, recipient route, provider, attempt, bounce, suppression, delivery status, and proof-of-delivery metadata.
assets.accessScope: Authorized communication, support, case, privacy, security, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Shows whether a required message was permitted, attempted, delivered, bounced, suppressed, or failed.

interfaces.name: communication delivery api
interfaces.description: Purpose-filtered send and delivery status.

governance.retention: Retain delivery evidence for operational, consent, complaint, and security needs; avoid retaining message content here.
governance.sharingPolicy: Share delivery state with the initiating workflow; restrict provider identifiers and recipient routes.

subGroups.name: Subscriptions and affiliate commerce
subGroups.description: Professional recurring revenue and partner demand compensation.

assets.name: Subscription and Credit Ledger
assets.description: Professional package contracts, credit bundles, invoices, tax, payments, direct-debit status, adjustments, refunds, collections, and accounting references.
assets.accessScope: The professional account and authorized commercial, finance, entitlement, claims, collections, legal, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: The financial system of record for recurring packages, purchased credits, and related money movement.

interfaces.name: subscription and billing api
interfaces.description: Contract, invoice, payment, adjustment, and balance access.

governance.retention: Retain accounting, tax, contract, payment, collections, and dispute records for the applicable legal entity's statutory schedule.
governance.sharingPolicy: Restrict line-level finance data to the account and authorized staff; use tokenized provider references.

assets.name: Affiliate Attribution
assets.description: Partner, contract, placement, category, tracked interaction, embed or API context, consent provenance, request link, attribution status, and acceptance reference.
assets.accessScope: The relevant partner and authorized affiliate, qualification, privacy, finance, case, analytics, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Explains whether and why a project request is attributable and potentially payable to a demand partner.

interfaces.name: affiliate attribution api
interfaces.description: Placement, request, acceptance, and attribution status.

governance.retention: Retain through the attribution, acceptance, settlement, dispute, and approved analytical periods; then minimize identifiers.
governance.sharingPolicy: Partners see their own placement and decision status, never unrelated homeowner or competing-partner data.

assets.name: Partner Settlement
assets.description: Accepted affiliate lead lines, agreed tariff, duplicate or reversal, monthly self-billing statement, dispute, approval, payment, and accounting reference.
assets.accessScope: The relevant partner and authorized affiliate, finance, legal, case, and audit workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: The auditable commercial record by which Solvari compensates a partner for accepted leads.

interfaces.name: partner settlement api
interfaces.description: Statement line, dispute, approval, and payment status.

governance.retention: Retain statements, tariffs, approvals, payments, tax, and disputes for the applicable statutory and contractual schedule.
governance.sharingPolicy: A partner receives only its own statement and supporting decision references; finance systems receive minimum payment data.

rootGroups.name: Integration, Migration, and Operational Evidence
rootGroups.description: Cross-brand mapping, service reliability, access audit, and reconstructable operational change.

subGroups.name: Acquired marketplace continuity
subGroups.description: Semantic and identifier provenance for controlled integration of brands and cohorts.

assets.name: Brand Migration Map
assets.description: Source and target system, identifier, taxonomy, consent, contract, entitlement, review, URL, checkpoint, exception, reconciliation, rollback, and decommission mapping.
assets.accessScope: Tightly authorized migration, domain-owner, privacy, finance, trust, security, audit, and rollback workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Preserves semantics and reconstructable provenance as acquired-brand state moves onto shared products.

interfaces.name: migration registry api
interfaces.description: Cohort, mapping, checkpoint, exception, and reconciliation state.

governance.retention: Retain mappings and reconciliation evidence through decommission, applicable legal schedules, and proven downstream independence.
governance.sharingPolicy: Restrict raw mappings and source credentials; expose only cohort status and authorized reconciliation evidence.

subGroups.name: Audit and reliability evidence
subGroups.description: Durable evidence for access, operator decisions, changes, incidents, and recovery.

assets.name: Operational Audit Event
assets.description: Authentication, authorization, data disclosure, operator action, override, policy change, API use, migration, incident, service-level, and recovery evidence.
assets.accessScope: Tightly authorized security, privacy, reliability, incident, audit, legal, and specific case workflows.
assets.businessMeaning: Allows impactful platform and human decisions to be reconstructed without relying on mutable operational records.

interfaces.name: operational audit stream
interfaces.description: Append-only audit and control events with authorized query views.

governance.retention: Use event-type-specific security, privacy, contract, and audit schedules with integrity protection and access logging.
governance.sharingPolicy: Restrict event detail to authorized investigations; provide redacted evidence and aggregates where possible.

stores.name: Identity and Tenant DB
stores.description: Strongly controlled platform identity, tenant, role, session, and authorization store.
stores.technology: managed relational database with protected credentials

stores.name: Homeowner and Consent DB
stores.description: System of record for homeowner profile, verified contact, preferences, and consent evidence.

stores.name: Project Taxonomy Catalog
stores.description: Versioned project categories, questions, guidance, and rules.

stores.name: Project Request DB
stores.description: System of record for property context, project drafts, submissions, and lifecycle state.

stores.name: Request Media Object Store
stores.description: Encrypted project photo and document storage with short-lived access grants and malware scanning.

stores.name: Professional Account DB
stores.description: System of record for specialist accounts, verification, profiles, services, regions, and capacity.

stores.name: Marketplace Decision DB
stores.description: Versioned qualification, matching, explanation, approval, and override decisions.

stores.name: Lead and Entitlement Ledger
stores.description: Idempotent lead, pricing, entitlement, credit reservation, consumption, and reversal state.

stores.name: Campaign and Professional CRM DB
stores.description: Campaign configuration, pacing, professional pipeline, tasks, and outcomes.

stores.name: Conversation and Delivery Store
stores.description: Permission-aware messages, threads, templates, attempts, bounces, suppression, and delivery evidence.

stores.name: Trust, Review, and Case DB
stores.description: Segregated review, risk, evidence, complaint, claim, decision, and appeal state.

stores.name: Professional Commercial Ledger
stores.description: Subscriptions, bundles, invoices, taxes, payments, adjustments, collections, and accounting references.

stores.name: Affiliate Attribution and Settlement Ledger
stores.description: Partner contracts, placements, attribution, accepted lead lines, statements, disputes, and payments.

stores.name: Marketplace Analytics Lakehouse
stores.description: Governed marketplace events, semantic metrics, aggregates, cohorts, features, and experiments.

stores.name: Marketplace Migration Registry
stores.description: Source-target mappings, cohorts, checkpoints, exceptions, reconciliations, rollback, and decommission evidence.

stores.name: Immutable Operational Audit Store
stores.description: Integrity-protected access, disclosure, operator, policy, migration, incident, and recovery evidence.
